title: Why You Can't Be Good At Classroom Management
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin pushes back on the litany of excuses teachers offer for why they cannot achieve a well-behaved class, from Title 1 schools and high numbers of students with learning disabilities to lack of administrative support and unmotivated parents. His central claim, drawn from founding SCM in 2009 and observing thousands of teachers since, is that none of these circumstances actually determine success or failure. The real cause of struggling classroom management, he argues, is a lack of knowledge rather than external conditions, and only by learning and applying what actually works can teachers abandon their excuses and experience real success. The concrete move he recommends is to start with SCM's foundational resources, learning the core principles before layering in any situational strategies, on the premise that knowledge, not circumstance, is the deciding variable.
points: Common excuses like Title 1 status, high ADHD counts, or lack of administrative support are real challenges but do not determine success or failure.
The actual cause of struggling classroom management is a lack of knowledge, not the difficulty of a teacher's specific circumstances.
Only by experiencing real success can teachers finally discard the excuses that have been holding them back.
Learning and applying foundational classroom management principles first is the recommended starting point before addressing any situational challenge.
quotes: I started SCM in 2009. Since then I’ve heard every possible reason why you can’t be good at classroom management.
The truth is, you can have the class you want. I’ve done it over and over again and know of thousands of other SCM teachers who’ve done the same.
These are challenges. Nearly every teacher must deal with them. But they don’t determine success 0r failure.
The real reason teachers struggle with classroom management isn’t because of outside circumstances. It’s because they lack knowledge.

Only by learning and applying what actually works will they see the light. Only by experiencing success can they finally throw away the excuses holding them back and embrace the career they really want.
